gap_statement: Production code provides single-job orchestration (run_jev_job in geometry_jev_execution.py), formal plan/admission/bridge validators, GeometryJevRequestLedger, and metered_jev_run, but NO formal 4-job GP6 CLI launcher (analogous to GP5's formal_order_driver.py) currently exists in the repository. Therefore G00-G03 cannot be launched as-is.

minimal_wiring_plan.why_outside_src: Placing the thin batch driver in an output/runner package (matching GP5's GEOM_CANDIDATES_GP5_FORMAL_ORDER_RUNNER_20261120_01/formal_order_driver.py) preserves the QA-reviewed 611-file production source_identity (68b879c5759b5a6df33fe8184019234bcb06e06483596f86390ca6c9974ca48e) and avoids invalidating the 28-file delta review.
cli_arguments: --api-key-file <optional path or TYPESAFE_API_KEY env; only loaded inside JevTransport during --execute>
--execute (optional flag; omitted by default so driver runs PREFLIGHT_ONLY with 0 dispatches and 0 sends)
zero_dispatch_preflight_guarantees: Step 1: validate_jev_plan(plan), verify status=='FROZEN', scope=='GP6_EXPOSED_TRAIN_JEV_F0_ONLY', jobs==[G00,G01,G02,G03], per_job_max_sends==19, shared_max_sends==model_calls_max==76, source_identity & publication_policy_digest & environment_digest match live environment.
Step 2: validate_monitor_snapshot(monitor_snapshot) against live Linux Anaconda Python 3.13.5 / NumPy 2.1.3 / SciPy 1.15.3 / HiGHS 1.8.0.
Step 3: Load and adapt both EXPOSED_TRAIN tasks from DATA_JEV_PACKAGING_LOAD_20261102_02 and verify raw_sha256 & adapted identity match plan['tasks'].

Step 4: Verify initial state of BOTH ledgers: (a) request_ledger_path has requests==[] and matches frozen plan_digest/19/76; (b) call_ledger_path has calls==[], counts=={0,0,0}, evidence=='REAL_KERNEL', limits=={76,4096}, matching frozen plan_digest.
Step 5: validate_kernel_bridge(kernel_bridge, plan, monitor_snapshot) and validate_jev_admission(plan, monitor_snapshot, admission, kernel_bridge).
Step 6: For all 4 jobs (G00, G01, G02, G03), call load_jev_config(...) and validate_jev_request_ledger_binding(...) in read-only mode (without sending any HTTP request).

Step 7: Re-verify both ledgers still have 0 sends, 0 assessments, 0 LP calls. If ANY step 1-7 fails, exit non-zero immediately BEFORE creating --run-root or invoking run_jev_job (strictly 0 business dispatches, 0 model calls, 0 monitor calls).
sequential_dispatch_and_halt_rules: Only when --execute is explicitly passed AND all 7 preflight steps pass AND --run-root does not yet exist:

Instantiate shared GeometryJevRequestLedger(root=Path(plan['request_ledger_path']).parent, plan_digest=digest(plan), per_job_max_sends=19, shared_max_sends=76, allow_real_transport=True) and JevTransport(cfg, api_key_file=args.api_key_file).

Loop strictly in order G00 -> G01 -> G02 -> G03 calling run_jev_job(plan, job_id, adapted, monitor_snapshot=snap, admission=admission, root=run_root, transport=transport, ledger=ledger, kernel_receipt=kernel_bridge).
Normal job endings (COMPLETE, NO_CANDIDATE, PREDICTED_STATIC_INSTABILITY, UNASSESSABLE) are recorded in run.json and proceed to the next job.

Immediate batch halt (break loop, leave remaining jobs NOT_RUN in run.json, no implicit retry) on first UNKNOWN_SEND, PROVIDER_FAILURE, INVALID_RESPONSE, BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, TECHNICAL_FAILURE, CANCELLED, or uncaught exception.
